description: This PHP source file generates dynamic enumeration form fields for the SuiteCRM platform. It includes logic for handling multi-select options, radio button configurations, language-specific string management, and dropdown options generation within the form building process.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: A class for JSON encoding and decoding, used for serializing data within the form rendering process.

methods.name: get_body
methods.description: Generates form HTML for dynamic enum fields based on vardef parameters, request parameters, and language strings. It configures dropdown options, default selections, and whether to display as radio buttons, ultimately returning the fetched template rendering.
